channel.title: Bishal Regmi | Blog
channel.description: Going back through old projects, redoing them honestly, and writing down what the data actually says.

item.title: Will it snow tomorrow? Rebuilding my first model honestly
item.description: The properly built version of my first model: a next-day snow predictor that has to beat real baselines on a fair test. Whether it snows turns out to be genuinely predictable. How much falls, barely at all, and the difference is the whole lesson.

item.title: Going back to my first data science project
item.description: Reopening my first real data science project, finding where it went wrong, and redoing it properly: a real trend test on the full record, a couple of broken weather stations, and a warming signal that turns up on every continent.
